image_description: A medium shot of two musicians performing with bassoons. In the foreground, a young woman with long blonde hair holds a bassoon diagonally across her body, her fingers positioned on the keys. In the background, an older man in a suit also plays a bassoon. The instruments are made of dark reddish-brown wood with silver metal keywork. Sheet music is visible on a stand in the lower left.
